inlines.v: MINDLESS, adjective Inattentive; heedless; forgetful; negligent; careless. Cursed Athens, mindless of thy worth. 1. Not endued with mind or intellectual powers; as mindless bodies. 2. Stupid; unthinking; as a mindless slave.
